translations.web: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.
translations.bsb: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed: one will be taken and the other left.
translations.kjv: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
translations.asv: I say unto you, In that night there shall be two men on one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
